{{wiktionary|eighteen}}

'''18''' ('''eighteen''') is the [[natural number]] following [[17 (number)|17]] and preceding [[19 (number)|19]].

==Mathematics==
18 is a [[semiperfect number]]<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A005835|Pseudoperfect (or semiperfect) numbers|access-date=2016-05-31}}</ref> and an [[abundant number]]. In the [[classification of finite simple groups]], there are 18 infinite families of groups.<ref>{{cite book | last=Wilson | first=Robert A. | author-link = Robert Arnott Wilson | title=The finite simple groups | publisher=[[Springer-Verlag]] | location=Berlin, New York | series=[[Graduate Texts in Mathematics]] | isbn=978-1-84800-987-5 | doi=10.1007/978-1-84800-988-2 | year=2009 | zbl=1203.20012 | volume=251 | page=3 }}</ref>

Although 18 and σ(18) = 39 are not coprime, 18 is known to be a [[friendly number|solitary number]]. 18 is the smallest number known to have this property; for 10, 14, and 15, their status as friendly or solitary is not known.

==In science==
===Chemistry===
The [[18-Electron rule|18-electron rule]] is a [[rule of thumb]] in [[transition metal]] [[chemistry]] for characterising and predicting the stability of [[Metal complex#Metal complexes|metal complexes]].

==In religion and literature==
===Judaism===
* The [[Hebrew language|Hebrew]] word for "life" is {{Lang|he|חי}} (''[[Chai (symbol)|chai]]''), which has a [[gematria|numerical value]] of 18. Consequently, a custom has arisen in Jewish circles to give donations and monetary gifts in multiples of 18 as an expression of blessing for long life.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Benjaminson|first=Chani|title=What is the reason for the custom to give money gifts in multiples of 18 -- 18, 36, 54, etc.?|url=https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/484894/jewish/What-is-the-reason-giving-money-in-multiples-of-18.htm|url-status=live|access-date=January 19, 2022|website=Chabad.org|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20071227215754/http://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/484894/jewish/What-is-the-reason-giving-money-in-multiples-of-18.htm  |archive-date = 2007-12-27  }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Chai, Its Meaning and Significance {{!}} Shiva, Jewish Mourning|url=https://www.shiva.com/learning-center/commemorate/chai|access-date=2020-11-18|website=www.shiva.com}}</ref>
* In [[Judaism]], in the [[Talmud]]; [[Pirkei Avot]] (5:25), Rabbi Yehudah ben Teime gives the age of 18 as the appropriate age to get married (''"Ben shmonah esra lechupah"'', at eighteen years old to the [[Chupah]] (marriage canopy)). (See [[Coming of age]], [[Age of majority]]).
* The [[Amidah]] prayer is also known Shemoneh Esrei as (sh'MOH-nuh ES-ray, which means "eighteen") because it has eighteen blessings.

===Other===
* In [[Ancient Roman]] custom the number 18 can symbolise a [[blood relative]].
* In Hinduism, in the [[Mahabharata]], the number appears in 18 books (Parvas), the 18 chapters of the [[Bhagavad Gita]], the 18 days of the [[Kurukshetra War]], and the 18 [[Akshauhini]] divisions of armies. There are also 18 major and 18 minor [[Puranas]].

==As lucky or unlucky number==
* In [[Numbers in Chinese culture|Chinese tradition]], 18 is pronounced {{Lang-zh|c=十八|p=shí bā|labels=no}} and is considered a lucky number due to similarity with {{Lang-zh|c=實發|p=shì fā|labels=no}} 'definitely get rich', 'to get rich for sure'.{{cn|date=March 2025}}

==Age 18==
{{see also|Age of majority|Voting age|Drinking age|Smoking age|Marriageable age|Age of consent}}
In most countries, 18 is the [[age of majority]], in which a minor becomes a legal adult. It is also the [[voting age]], [[marriageable age]], [[drinking age]] and [[smoking age]] in most countries, though sometimes these ages are different than the age of majority.  Many [[Website|websites]] restrict adult content to visitors [[Minor (law)|who claim to be at least 18 years old.]]

*In the United States, 18 is the:
**[[age of consent|Age for sexual consent]] in eleven states and under federal law.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://aspe.hhs.gov/report/statutory-rape-guide-state-laws-and-reporting-requirements-summary-current-state-laws/sexual-intercourse-minors |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170206085915/https://aspe.hhs.gov/report/statutory-rape-guide-state-laws-and-reporting-requirements-summary-current-state-laws/sexual-intercourse-minors |url-status=dead |archive-date=February 6, 2017 |title=STATUTORY RAPE: A GUIDE TO STATE LAWS AND REPORTING REQUIREMENTS. SEXUAL INTERCOURSE WITH MINORS |newspaper=Aspe|date=23 November 2015 }}</ref>
**Minimum age to purchase firearms in thirty-eight states with the exception of handguns (21 under federal law).<ref>{{cite web |title=Minimum Age |url=https://giffords.org/lawcenter/gun-laws/policy-areas/who-can-have-a-gun/minimum-age/ |website=Giffords}}</ref>
**[[Marriageable age]] without parental consent except for [[Nebraska]] (19), [[Mississippi]], (19) and Puerto Rico (21).
**The minimum age at which one can purchase, rent, or buy tickets to [[NC-17]]-rated films or buy video games with an [[Entertainment Software Rating Board|Adults Only]] rating.
*In the UK, 18 is the legal age to purchase a [[British Board of Film Classification|BBFC]] "18" rated film.
*In Japan, 18 is the minimum age at which one can purchase, rent, or buy tickets to [[Eirin|R18+]] rated movies or buy video games with a [[Computer Entertainment Rating Organization|Z]] rating, although 20 is their cultural age of adulthood.

==In sports==
* In [[association football]] (soccer), "the 18" is a slang term for the [[penalty area]].
